statement: Both matched-advice methods recovered zero held-out targets across 32 attempts within 512 online steps;6076 advice logs were independently replayed.
scope: Two advice cardinalities 610/2428, two methods, eight reused targets; attempts share targets and setup.

lesson: A null result with shared targets motivates different predictions and samples, not universal rejection.
